description: Source code for curriculum build process in a FreeCodeCamp project, including functions for creating block and superblock structures, parsing curriculum data, and building the full curriculum with validation and filtering.

methods.name: getBlockCreator
methods.description: Creates a BlockCreator instance configured for a specific language and options.

methods.name: getTranslationEntry
methods.description: Retrieves translation entries for a given English ID and fallback text across all languages.

methods.name: createCommentMap
methods.description: Builds a map of English comments to their translations in all supported languages.

methods.name: addSuperblockStructure
methods.description: Constructs superblock structures from filenames, transforming each superblock.

methods.name: addBlockStructure
methods.description: Adds detailed block structure info to each superblock's blocks.

methods.name: getSuperblocks
methods.description: Returns a list of superblocks containing a specific block.

methods.name: validateBlocks
methods.description: Validates that all blocks in superblocks have corresponding structure files and vice versa.

methods.name: parseCurriculumStructure
methods.description: Parses and validates the curriculum structure, returning superblock and certification data.

methods.name: buildCurriculum
methods.description: Builds the full curriculum for a given language, including superblocks and certifications, with validation and filtering.
